title: Parsley Health video reviews carousel
description: Member video reviews: an eyebrow and a narrow light serif title at the left, a track of tall 9:16 video stills to the right, each framed by a 1px forest line with a thin play ring in the middle, the member's name in sage over a forest rule and a short quote; the first card is framed whole and carries an ochre pill. A small sage arrow pages the track. On phones the title centres, the current card sits in the middle with its neighbours fading out at the edges, and arrows with dots sit below. Stills grow 5% on hover.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows and dots (hydrate: visible); the track still scrolls by touch without it
each still is a 221×393 slot filled like object-fit: cover; empty, a soft placeholder stands in
the play ring is decoration; wrap the still in your own player link via media
